name: a2a
description: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for Claude Code: call remote A2A agents and expose Claude Code as an A2A agent over JSON-RPC (HTTP+SSE), HTTP+JSON and gRPC.

port.title: Server HTTP port
port.description: Port for the agent card, JSON-RPC (+SSE) and HTTP+JSON endpoints.

transports.title: Server transports
transports.description: all serves JSON-RPC (+SSE), HTTP+JSON and gRPC. http serves JSON-RPC and HTTP+JSON only. grpc serves gRPC only; the HTTP port then serves just the agent card, which clients need to find the gRPC endpoint.

host.title: Server bind address
host.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps the server local. Any other address requires an API key, an OIDC issuer or a client CA.

name.title: Agent name
name.description: The name this session advertises in its agent card.

apiKey.title: Server API key
apiKey.description: Callers may send it in the X-API-Key header. Empty: no API key.

oidcIssuer.title: Server OIDC / OAuth 2.0 issuer
oidcIssuer.description: Callers may send a JWT from this issuer as Authorization: Bearer. Its OpenID Connect discovery document, or else its OAuth 2.0 metadata (RFC 8414), and its key set are fetched at start. Needs an audience. Empty: no tokens.

oidcAudience.title: Server OIDC audience
oidcAudience.description: The aud a caller's JWT must carry.

requiredScopes.title: Server: required scopes
requiredScopes.description: Scopes a caller's JWT must all carry, separated by spaces. The card lists them, so clients ask for them. Empty: none.

tlsCert.title: Server TLS certificate
tlsCert.description: PEM file. With the key, the server serves HTTPS and gRPC over TLS. Empty: plaintext.

tlsKey.title: Server TLS private key
tlsKey.description: PEM file for the TLS certificate.

tlsClientCa.title: Server: client CA (mutual TLS)
tlsClientCa.description: PEM file. Every connection must then present a client certificate this CA signed, as well as any other credential. Needs the TLS certificate. Empty: no mutual TLS.

cardSigningKey.title: Server: agent card signing key
cardSigningKey.description: Private key file (PEM or JWK; EC, Ed25519 or RSA). The card is signed with it, and its public key served at /.well-known/jwks.json. Empty: unsigned card.

maxConcurrentTasks.title: Server: tasks at once
maxConcurrentTasks.description: The most incoming tasks that run at the same time; one more fails at once as busy. 0: no limit.

tasksPerMinute.title: Server: tasks a minute per caller
tasksPerMinute.description: The most tasks one caller (an API key, a JWT subject, or anonymous) may start in a minute. 0: no limit.

authFailuresPerMinute.title: Server: failed sign-ins a minute
authFailuresPerMinute.description: Failed sign-ins a client may make in a minute before it is refused outright, so a key cannot be guessed. 0: no limit.

autoServe.title: Start server with each session
autoServe.description: Run /a2a-serve automatically when a session starts.

clientApiKey.title: Client API key
clientApiKey.description: Sent to remote agents whose card asks for an API key. Empty: $A2A_API_KEY.

oauthClientId.title: Client OAuth client id
oauthClientId.description: With the secret, fetches a token with the client-credentials grant from the endpoint a remote agent's card names. Empty: $A2A_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

oauthScope.title: Client OAuth scope
oauthScope.description: The scope to ask for, if the provider needs one. Empty: $A2A_OAUTH_SCOPE.

oauthAudience.title: Client OAuth audience
oauthAudience.description: The audience to ask for, for providers that take one (Auth0). Empty: $A2A_OAUTH_AUDIENCE.

oauthRedirectPort.title: Client OAuth redirect port
oauthRedirectPort.description: Loopback port for the authorization-code sign-in, for providers that need the exact redirect URI registered (http://127.0.0.1:PORT/callback). 0: any free port.

clientUsername.title: Client HTTP Basic username
clientUsername.description: Sent to agents whose card asks for HTTP Basic. Empty: $A2A_HTTP_USERNAME.

clientTlsCa.title: Client: CA to trust
clientTlsCa.description: PEM file, trusted instead of the system's CAs for HTTPS and gRPC over TLS. Empty: $A2A_TLS_CA, else the system's.

clientTlsCert.title: Client TLS certificate (mutual TLS)
clientTlsCert.description: PEM file presented to agents that ask for mutual TLS. Empty: $A2A_TLS_CERT.

clientTlsKey.title: Client TLS private key
clientTlsKey.description: PEM file for the client certificate. Empty: $A2A_TLS_KEY.

trustedCardKeys.title: Client: trusted card keys
trustedCardKeys.description: A key set (JWKS) URL or file that agent card signatures must verify against. Empty: $A2A_CARD_JWKS, else the key set the signature names on the agent's own origin.

requireSignedCards.title: Client: require signed cards
requireSignedCards.description: Refuse agents whose card is not signed.
